description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of examples and the minFDE20 value for two different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “minFDE20” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.20 to 0.24, with tick marks at 0.21, 0.22, 0.23, and 0.24. The first line, representing “ST-ES”, is blue with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at a value of approximately 0.24 when the number of examples is 0, declines to a value of 0.21 at an x-value of 2, fluctuates between approximately 0.21 and 0.22 until x equals 6, and ends at approximately 0.22. The second line, representing “Random”, is orange with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 0.22 when the number of examples is 0, declines to 0.21 at an x-value of 2, and then steadily increases to approximately 0.23 at x equals 8.
